title: Reserve Bank of India announces ₹1 lakh crore OMO sale in 3 tranches to boost liquidity
text: Reserve Bank of India announces ₹1 lakh crore OMO sale in 3 tranches to boost liquidity. The RBI will conduct Open Market Operation sale auctions of ₹1 lakh crore in three tranches to address liquidity conditions, with the first auction of ₹50,000 crore set for September 17, and two follow-up auctions on September 21 and 28.
